migration_bug_fixed.bug: notes column declared NOT NULL but INSERT passes explicit NULL for 13 rows -> violates constraint on truly-clean install
migration_bug_fixed.why_hidden_before: Prior 'clean install PASS' ran on containers with pre-existing rows; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING skipped the INSERT so the NULL violation never surfaced
migration_bug_fixed.fix: notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' -> notes TEXT DEFAULT '' (notes is optional metadata)
migration_bug_fixed.impact: Required for first clean production deploy (fresh VPS would hit same bug)

5_food_happy_path.root_cause_of_prior_fail: Read/write asymmetry in storefront dev: /api/checkout/place writes via saveLocalOrder (.data/orders.json) when checkout-svc is unavailable, but fetchOrderForDispatch (used by packing-proof) called order-svc via kong and, on a non-ok/404 response, returned null immediately — the local-store fallback existed ONLY in the catch block (network error), never for a reachable-but-404 svc.
5_food_happy_path.fix: lib/server/merchantOrders.ts fetchOrderForDispatch: only return the svc order when res.ok AND a valid order body is present; otherwise fall through to the local orderStore (getOrderById) whenever allowLocalOrders() is true. Read path is now symmetric with the write path in checkout/place.
